DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT by LAFAYETTE-BOYNTONAPARTMENTCORPORATION and HP LAFAYETTE-BOYNTON HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., aS nominee Real Property: Lots1and10inBlock3623 on the Tax Map of The City of NewYorkfor Bronx County, NewYork Record and Return to: Lafayette Global B LLC 118-35QueensBoulevard ForestHills,NewYork11375

DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT         DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., as nominee (the “HDFC"), a New York not-for- profit corporation established pursuant to Article Xl of the New York State Private Housing Finance Law, having an office at 242 West 36th Street, 3rd Floor, New York, New York 10018 HDFC, the “Declarant"), a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York, having an office at 118-35 Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills, NY 11375. RECITALS: A.HDFCis thefee owner of the parcel ofrealestate and the improvements thereondesignated as Lot 1 ("Parcel A") in Block 3623 on the Tax Map of The City of New York for Bronx County, New York (the “Tax Map"), described in Exhibit A annexed hereto, and which is adjacent toParcel B. B. HDFC is the fee owner of the parcel of real estate and the improvements thereon designated as Lot 10 ("Parcel B") in Block 3623 on the Tax Map described in Exhibit B annexed hereto, and which is adjacent to Parcel A. C.LBACistheequitableandbeneficialownerofParcelAandParcelBpursuanttothat certain Declaration of Interest and Nominee Agreement dated as of October 27, 2011 and recorded on November 11, 2011 in CRFN 2011000401069 in the City Register of the City ofNewYork. D. Declarant or its successor intends to construct a new building or buildings on Parcel B and to construct other improvements associated with such new building or buildings (said new building or buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof or additions thereto not prohibited by the provisions of this Declaration, hereinafter referred to collectively as the“New Building"). E. Parcel A and Parcel B comprise a single “zoning lot,”" as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (such single zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or otherwise modified from time to time, being herein called the “Combined Zoning Lot"). F.The parties hereto intend, pursuant to this Declaration, to: (i) provide for the related grants of easements and restrictive covenants as more particularly set forth herein, (ii) set forth the portion of the Development Rights appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot which establish, and set forth, certain rights and obligations of the parties hereto. 1
